verdict.rationale: The SDK package ships with the official Claude Code CLI bundled and drives it as a supervised `claude` subprocess. A probe confirms an official CLI reference exists, and docs show commands like `claude agents` and CLI-driven MCP setup. Missing for 10: an SDK-specific CLI reference describing commands and flags (the CLI is Claude Code's, inherited by the SDK), and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Claude Code CLI is automatically bundled with the package - no separate installation required! The SDK will use the bundled CLI by default.
The Agent SDK spawns and supervises a claude CLI subprocess that owns a shell, a working directory, and session files on disk.
Agent view, opened with `claude agents`, is one screen for all your background sessions
